sentences.text:
Page 1 of 2
 Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.12474 Of 2018
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in proceeding with the construction of Mahila Mandali and Panchayat Office in the lands of the petitioners covered by survey Nos.319 and 320 situated at Tippannapet Village, Jagital Mandal and District without following due process of law.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development and learned Standing Counsel for the Gram Panchayats appearing for the respondents.
3.

While admitting the Writ Petition this court passed interim orders on 12.04.2018 and directed to maintain status quo with regard to the possession of the subject land, however, the order will not preclude the respondents from proceeding strictly in accordance SK,J with law.
In spite of lapse of more than six years, the respondents did not chose to file vacate petition or counter denying the averments made by the petitioners in the writ affidavit.

4. In view of the same, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioners in respect of the subject lands without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the lands of the petitioners, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
